Overseer/Compendium Website -

HUGO SITE SETUP
PART 1 / PROJECT MISSION

Build a static site for TekTribe Chronicles Compendium using Hugo + IPFS/Fleek. Domain: napisnest.com now, overseer.ae later. No Cloudflare. No analytics. No third-party scripts. Local-first sovereignty stack.
PART 2 / TECH STACK

    Static Generator: Hugo extended version
    Theme: PaperMod (hierarchical documentation style)
    Hosting: IPFS via Fleek CLI
    Archive: ARweave pin
    OS: Windows PowerShell, username Nefs
    All fonts/assets served locally from /static

PART 3 / CONTENT STRUCTURE
content/
├── _index.md
├── about.md
├── part1/    Cosmology of the Continuum
├── part2/    Architecture of Corruption
├── part3/    The Guardian, Avatar & Allies
├── part4/    The Surveillance State
├── part5/    The Rise of Goliath
├── part6/    Covenant of the Arc
├── part7/    Liberation Technologies
├── part8/    Fabric of the Future - Protocols
└── part9/    The Beast Below & Light Within

Each part folder contains _index.md plus chapter .md files.
PART 4 / CONFIG REQUIREMENTS
baseURL = @url:`https://napisnest.com`
languageCode = en-us
title = TekTribe Chronicles
theme = PaperMod
params.author = Overseer AE
params.description = Compendium of the Collective
params.defaultTheme = dark
PART 5 / MENU NAVIGATION

Top-level menu items:

    Part I => Cosmology
    Part II => Corruption
    Part III => Guardian
    Part IV => Surveillance
    Part V => Goliath
    Part VI => Covenant
    Part VII => Liberation
    Part VIII => Protocols
    Part IX => Beast Below
    Oracle
    About

PART 6 / BUILD COMMANDS
winget install gohugoio.hugo
cd C:\Users\Nefs\Projects
hugo new site CompendiumSite
cd CompendiumSite
git init
git submodule add @url:`https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod.git` themes/PaperMod
hugo server -D

Production build: hugo --gc --minify
PART 7 / DEPLOY PIPELINE

Phase 1 (IONOS FTP): Upload /public folder contents to IONOS web root.

Phase 2 (Fleek/IPFS):
npm install -g @file:`fleek-platform/cli`
fleek login
fleek sites init
fleek sites deploy

Phase 3 (ARweave): Pin /public, update front matter with CID.
PART 8 / FORMATTING RULES

    Tables as text-line format with emoji indicators
    Arrow syntax: => (not unicode arrows)
    SoL capitalization (Source of Light), not SOL
    Collective voice: "we" not "I"
    Dark mode default

PART 9 / DOMAIN MIGRATION

When overseer.ae acquired:

    Update baseURL in config.toml
    Run hugo --gc --minify
    Redeploy to Fleek
    Bind custom domain in Fleek dashboard
    Set up 301 redirect from old domain (optional)
